description.p: Everythux finds files by name as you type. It indexes mounted ext4 volumes into a local SQLite database and searches the whole index in memory, so results appear immediately even with millions of files.

ul.li: Sortable columns: name, path, type, date modified and size
Search operators and filters such as ext:, size: and dm:
Exclusion rules with patterns, for example node_modules or build output folders
Re-index a single volume or folder, or rebuild everything with Ctrl+Shift+R
Open the containing folder with the file selected in your file manager
Optional preview pane for images, PDFs, audio and video
A command-line tool, everythux-cli, for scripts
